requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Backgrounds read as warm white, product image wells as white, headings as pine green #264C43, and information panels as cream #F5F0E6. Allow ordinary rendering and display differences, but fail a visibly different heading color, panel color or background system.

Each main image identifies its own kit by the correct name, code and USD 24 price. Each shopping card presents both complete records, with USD 24 visibly associated with each individual kit. Swapped names or codes, missing prices, or a price presented as buying both kits fail.

Where a full motif is visible, Fern Study has one upright curved stem and six opposite leaf pairs; Daisy Study has three eight-petal flowers, each with a stem and two leaves. Preprinted and partial views retain the same underlying design. Cropped material or stitch details need not expose the entire motif, but visible elements must agree with their SKU. Missing, extra or substituted motif elements fail.

Full motifs occupy a 100 × 100 mm design area relative to the supplied 150 mm inner hoop diameter and 250 × 250 mm fabric. Use visible component relationships or dimension annotations as evidence; permit perspective and close-up cropping. A full motif visibly enlarged or reduced to an incompatible physical scale fails. Printing a dimension on every image is not required.

The specifications occupy the initial process stage. Each records heading color #264C43, a 150 mm inner hoop diameter and all three exact purchase labels. The hierarchy is a one-page selling-points table with priorities, placements and minimum text sizes. The shot list assigns all ten final images and the video their roles, proportions and required content. Missing assignments, conflicting facts or absent required specification fields fail.

Each image fulfills its assigned shot-list purpose and required content. The main and shopping card visibly carry the exact brand and tagline with the applicable SKU records. Apply square main, 2:3 detail and 9:16 card proportions; an upper 20% information band; a lower 80% white product well; 5% outer margins; and minimum text height of 3% of the shorter side, with typography in the band. The main product group occupies 85–90% of the well's width and its heading follows the specified #264C43. The tabletop view arranges the Fern kit for starting work. Missing assigned content or incompatible relative geometry fails.

The inventory shows one hoop, one cotton square, four skeins, two No. 7 needles, one guide and one box, with 150/166 mm hoop diameters, 250 × 250 mm fabric, 38 mm needles, 100 × 140 mm guide and 270 × 270 × 35 mm box correctly recorded across the inventory and material panels. The inventory repeats the specified inner diameter and explicitly dimensions the hoop, fabric and guide. The material panel exposes cotton weave and two needles and lists T01 Pine #365744, T02 Sage #90A889, T03 Cream #F3E9D2 and T04 Ochre #C99236, each 8 m and six-strand. Inventory and tabletop preserve the physical size relationships of hoop, fabric and guide. Perspective is allowed; missing records, wrong stock or incompatible relative sizes fail.

Instructions progress through mounting, separating two strands and threading, stitching, and trimming/gathering the back; the preparation detail visibly separates two strands from six. Close-ups identify stem stitch on the T04 Ochre stem, satin stitch on T02 Sage left leaves and T01 Pine right leaves, and straight stitch on T03 Cream veins, using two working strands. The state panel shows a complete gray unstitched outline; a completed stem with the bottom three leaf pairs filled and veined and the upper three pairs still outlined; and all twelve leaves filled and veined. Different viewpoints are allowed. Wrong stitches, colors, sequence, partial-leaf placement or completion counts fail.

Completed examples in the finished panel, shopping card and purchase panel carry 'Finished example - stitch it yourself', with the card's label clearly associated with each kit's outcome. Scissors in the instruction, tabletop and purchase views carry 'You supply: scissors'. The purchase panel covers both kits in three distinct labeled groups and places one hoop, one SKU-specific fabric square, four skeins, two needles, one guide and one box per kit under 'In your kit'. Its labels repeat the specification exactly. Ambiguous label associations, incomplete stock or tools/outcomes classified as supplied goods fail.

Review the full video and its duration. It lasts ten seconds, shows the supplied Fern materials, visibly explains two-strand preparation and presents the completed outcome. Fern Study, EK-01 and USD 24 are readable, and completed work is labeled 'Finished example - stitch it yourself'. Component identity, stock, motif and thread assignments agree with the supplied references and final Fern images. Editing and camera movement may vary; missing required content, contradictory product facts or a different duration fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation contains at least eight pages and recognizably reuses both specifications and every one of the ten final images. It also includes three stills identifiable as frames from the delivered video. Scaling and editorial cropping are allowed when the reused source remains identifiable. A fact-mapping page links brand colors, quantities, dimensions, fixed wording and both SKU records to explicitly named visuals. Missing sources, replacement artwork, fewer than three video stills or an incomplete mapping fails.
